item.title: GREGORY WRIGHTSTONE: Refrigerants Are No Global Warming Threat
China Warns Journalists, Threatens Consequences For Reporting ‘Distorted Facts’ Of Deadly Disaster
item.description: An arm of the Chinese government warned foreign media outlets Saturday against covering a Nov. 26 Hong Kong high-rise fire which left at least 159 dead in a manner painting Beijing in a negative light.

item.title: New Book Revives Unsettling Clues From Inside the Murdaugh Home
Previously Deported Illegal Reportedly Stabbed Victim On Same Rail System Ukrainian Refugee Iryna Zarutska Was Killed
item.description: The suspect charged Saturday for allegedly stabbing and seriously injuring a man on a Charlotte light rail train the night before was reportedly a previously deported illegal immigrant.

item.title: Musk Fires Back as EU Slaps X With $140 Million Fine
item.description: The European Commission announced the hefty fine on Friday, saying X violated multiple sections of the Digital Services Act (DSA), the sweeping online-regulation law the bloc adopted in 2022.

item.title: White House Issues Dire Warning on Europe’s Future as Migration Reshapes Continent
item.description: The White House also cites migration costs and crime statistics across Europe as evidence of strain, pointing to data from the Netherlands, France, Denmark, and Germany.

item.title: DAVID BLACKMON: Trump Deals Biden’s EV Dreams A Death Blow
item.description: President Donald Trump dealt the dreams of former President Joe Biden for an all-electric fleet of American cars a fatal blow on Thursday by terminating the onerous Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) standards Biden invoked in 2022 and further tightened in 2024.

item.title: JENNY BETH MARTIN: Rubio Rights Ship At State
item.description: The State Department is finally undergoing the course correction it has long needed. According to recent reporting from FOX News, Secretary of State Marco Rubio has reinstated and promoted a number of career Foreign Service officers who were denied advancement under the Biden administration’s expansive diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) regime.
